cues: A simple, or symmetrical, ether has the same group on both sides, like diethyl ether.
A mixed, or unsymmetrical, ether has two different groups, like methoxyethane.
If one group is an aryl ring, as in anisole, methoxybenzene, it is an aromatic ether.
text: Ethers come in two classes. A simple, or symmetrical, ether has the same group on both sides, like diethyl ether. A mixed, or unsymmetrical, ether has two different groups, like methoxyethane. If one group is an aryl ring, as in anisole, methoxybenzene, it is an aromatic ether.
